**Larry** is a masculine given name in English, derived from Lawrence or Laurence.
It can be a shortened form of those names.
*   Larry Sanders (born 1954), American singer aka L.V.
*   Lawrence "Larry" Needlemeyer, a character from The Amazing World of Gumball, who works every job in the fictional city in Elmore.
*   Larry Daley, a character from the _Night at the Museum_ franchise.
